messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm updating the console observability quickstart to a slimline snippet that shows trace + cost annotation. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Looking for a quick review and a link sweep.

ben: Skimmed the draft, looks promising. One question: are we intentionally changing the trace key name to 'req' in the example? That might conflict with some SDK helpers. I'll leave inline comments.

maria: The idea was to keep the example minimal for quick onboarding. Full example lives in the advanced appendix. Current minimal snippet I put in the PR is: ```python
from redwood import Console
c = Console(api_key="AK_PLACEHOLDER")
tr = c.trace.start('req')
tr.annotate(cost=calc_cost())
```

lee: Small nit: please use an env var placeholder instead of AK_PLACEHOLDER (e.g., REDWOOD_API_KEY). Also mention that KV cache behavior isn't shown in the slim snippet.

olivia: UX request — could we add a one-line callout about metric cardinality? Folks tend to add high-cardinality tags in examples and it confuses customers later.

ben: Also the dashboard link in the doc currently points to /dashboards/preset-1 but that route changed last quarter. The correct path looks like /dashboards/console-presets. I can follow up with a tiny PR to update all old permalinks if needed.

maria: Good catches. I'll update the snippet to use REDWOOD_API_KEY, add the cardinality callout, and fix the dashboard URL. Can someone smoke-test the slim snippet locally? I don't have a local env with the SDK pinned.

jamie: Happy to smoke-test later today. Ping me when you push the fix.

deploy-bot: PR 4321 opened by maria — status: CI queued. :github:

maria: Pushed fixups: replaced API placeholder with REDWOOD_API_KEY, added callout about cardinality, and updated dashboard URL to /dashboards/console-presets. PTAL @ben @jamie

ben: LGTM apart from a doc-linter complaint about line length on the code block. I'll push a 1-line whitespace fix.

jamie: Tested the snippet on my laptop (SDK v0.9.2). It runs, though you get an import warning about the class name 'Console' being aliased in older SDKs — we should note the SDK minimum version (v0.9+) in the quickstart header.

olivia: Suggested callout copy: "Warning: high-cardinality labels (e.g., user_id, session_id) increase storage and query cost — prefer coarse buckets or sampling for per-request tags." Short and actionable.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll squash and merge after CI passes and backport to /v1 with a redirect note.

sre-ops: FYI — since the snippet annotates cost, double-check that example logs and CI don't accidentally leak real keys. Mask or redact in the published HTML.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR 4321. Merged by maria. Docs site updated and published to prod. :shipit:
